assets.prompt: Defense tower design sheet derived from a white-and-cyan powered armor pilot who dual-wields double-barrel energy pistols and has a glowing hexagonal chest core. One wide image showing the SAME tower at four upgrade stages, arranged in a single horizontal row left to right, evenly spaced, all standing on the same invisible ground line, identical 3/4 elevated camera angle for all four, stage 1 far left smallest and simplest, stage 4 far right tallest and most elaborate, no dividers and no frames between them. Stage 1: a compact white plated turret on a hexagonal base with one short twin-muzzle ion barrel. Stage 2: two stacked twin-barrel ion emitters with a glowing cyan hexagonal panel on the housing and gold trim. Stage 3: a wider hex-framed battery with three exposed ion barrels, external power conduit and magenta status strips. Stage 4: an angular fortress emplacement with paired long ion lance barrels, two small floating cyan hexagon rings orbiting above it, bright cyan energy charging in the muzzles. Palette: clean white armor, charcoal joints, gold trim, cyan energy lines, small magenta accents. Rapid-fire twin-stream ion weapon.
